```{r}
#Load in objects from StagePreProcessing
BaseModel <- readRDS(here::here("MalePreProcessing","BaseModel.rds"))
is2norm01 <- readRDS(here::here("rawdata","is2norm01.rds"))
merge <- readRDS(here::here("rawdata","mergemale.rds"))
```

```{r}
#Corrected K fold Validation - Base Model

set.seed(123)

k <- 10
n <- nrow(BaseModel)

# Create fold assignments
folds <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out = n))

# Storage
predictions <- vector("numeric", n)

for (i in 1:k) {
  train_idx <- which(folds != i)
  test_idx  <- which(folds == i)
  
  train_data <- BaseModel[train_idx, ]
  test_data  <- BaseModel[test_idx, ]
  
  # Fit model (example: linear regression)
  
BaseModelReg <- lm(maxFC ~ age_imputed, data = train_data) 

  # Predict on held-out fold
  predictions[test_idx] <- predict(BaseModelReg, newdata = test_data)
}

# Final dataframe of observed vs predicted
cv_results <- data.frame(
  observed  = BaseModel$maxFC,
  predicted = predictions
)

cv_results

#RMSE and R Squared Values
#RMSE: Measures how far your predictions are from the true values, on average
#Standardized RMSE: RMSE of your predictions compared to the true values, divided by standard dev of true values. The lower this value the better i.e if sRMSE is 1, your predictions are as good, on average, as model which predicts response with no predictor information

# Compute evaluation metrics
## RMSE
rmse_val <- caret::RMSE(cv_results$observed, cv_results$predicted)

## Standardised RMSE (RMSE divided by standard deviation of response)
sd_y <- sd(cv_results$observed)
std_rmse <- rmse_val / sd_y

# R2 - squared pearson correlation between response and predictions
baser2 <-
  cor(cv_results$observed, cv_results$predicted, method = "pearson") ^ {
    2}

print(paste0("Standardised RMSE: ", round(std_rmse, 3)))
print(paste0("R2 statistic: ", round(baser2, 3)))

```

```{r}
#Observed vs. Predicted - Base Model
cv_results = cv_results %>% mutate(Gender = "Male")


basemodelmaleplot <- ggplot(cv_results, aes(y = predicted, x = observed, colour = Gender)) +
  geom_point() +
  
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c("Male" = "blue"),
    name = "Gender"
  ) +
  
  xlim(-1, 12) +
  ylim(-1, 12) +
  
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 2, y = 10,
    label = paste0(
      "R² = ", round(baser2, 3),
      "\nsRMSE = ", round(std_rmse, 3)
    )
  ) +
  
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Log Observed maxFC",
    y = "Log Predicted maxFC",
    title = "Observed vs. Predicted maxFC: Base Model"
  ) +
  
  coord_fixed()

ggsave(
  here("figurespng", "basemodelmaleplot.png"),
  basemodelmaleplot,
  width = 5,
  height = 4,
  dpi = 500
)

saveRDS(
  basemodelmaleplot,
  here("figuresrds", "basemodelmaleplot.rds")
)
```



```{r}
# Univariate Gene Model
## Switching inner and outer loops
#Conceptual: Outer loop is CV folds and inner fold is genes. For each fold, we hold out part of data, fit many different gene models on the same training set, and predict all genes on same test set.

#Outer Loop

r <- ncol(is2norm01) 
n_genes <- r-1
n2 <- nrow(merge)


predgenematrix <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow =n2,
  ncol= n_genes,
  dimnames = list(
    merge$participant_id,
    colnames(is2norm01)[2:r]
  ))

set.seed(123)
k <- 10
n <- nrow(BaseModel)
folds <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out = n))  
models <- vector("list", r - 1)


for (fold in 1:k) {
  
  train_idx <- which(folds != fold)
  test_idx  <- which(folds == fold)
  

  train_data <- merge[train_idx, ]
  test_data  <- merge[test_idx, ]
  
for (i in 1:(r - 1)) {
  
  gene_name <- colnames(is2norm01)[i + 1]
  
  formula_i <- as.formula(
    paste("maxFC ~ age_imputed +", gene_name)
  )
  
  models[[i]] <- lm(formula_i, data = train_data)
  
}
  IntModels <- sapply(models, predict, newdata = test_data) #Uses all trained models from the inner loop to predict on the test set
 predgenematrix[test_idx,]<- IntModels #Stores all gene predictions for that fold, must happen after all models are trained and after predictions are generated
 
cat("Fold", fold, "finished\n")

}

predgenematrix
```

```{r}
#Calculating average RMSE across folds
predgenematrix <- as.data.frame(predgenematrix)
predgenematrix$participant_id <- rownames(predgenematrix)
predgenematrix <- BaseModel %>% select(participant_id, maxFC) %>% right_join(predgenematrix, by = "participant_id") %>% relocate(maxFC, .before = a1cf)


 gene_matrix <- as.matrix(predgenematrix[, 3:ncol(predgenematrix)])

y <- predgenematrix$maxFC   # your observed/measured data
y_matrix <- matrix(y, nrow = length(y), ncol = ncol(gene_matrix))

rmse_per_gene <- sqrt(colMeans((gene_matrix - y_matrix)^2))

std_rmse_per_gene <- rmse_per_gene/sd_y



#Appending Univariate Gene Model sRMSE and Base sRMSE to our genematrix
rmse_row <- c(NA, NA, std_rmse_per_gene)
basermse<- rep(std_rmse,times = ncol(is2norm01))
basermse<- c(NA, NA,basermse)

predgenematrix <- rbind(
  predgenematrix,
  Gene_Std_RMSE = rmse_row,
  Base_Std_RMSE = basermse
)

row.names(predgenematrix)[nrow(predgenematrix)-1] <- "Gene_Std_RMSE"
row.names(predgenematrix)[nrow(predgenematrix)]   <- "Base_Std_RMSE"

predgenematrix <- rbind(
  predgenematrix,
  Diff_Std_RMSE = as.numeric(predgenematrix["Gene_Std_RMSE", ]) -
              as.numeric(predgenematrix["Base_Std_RMSE", ])
)
```



```{r}
improvegenes <- predgenematrix %>%
  slice(n()) %>%                        # last row dynamically
  select(3:last_col()) %>%              # keep columns 3 to last
  select(where(~ any(. < 0))) %>%       # keep only genes with negative values
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "Genes",
    values_to = "Diff_RMSE"
  ) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(Diff_RMSE = abs(Diff_RMSE)) %>%
  arrange(desc(Diff_RMSE))

sum(predgenematrix[nrow(predgenematrix), 3: ncol(predgenematrix) ] < 0) # Some of genes added to the base model to prove to improve the base model

#2647 genes improved the Base Model
```

```{r}
# Visualizations: 10 best, 10 worst, 10 baseline (observed vs predicted)

finalgenes<- finalgenes %>% 
  mutate(gender = "Male") %>% 
  relocate(gender, .before = a1cf)

DiffRMSE <- predgenematrix %>% slice(n(),) %>% select(-c(participant_id, maxFC)) %>% as.vector()
#Top 10 Male Genes
plot_list <- list()

top10male <- improvegenes %>% slice(c(1:10),)
write_csv(top10male, glue("{myfilepath}MaleUnivariateScreening/top10male.csv"), col_names = TRUE)


for (i in 1:10) {
  
  top10malegene <- as.character(top10male$Genes[i])
  maleintr2  <- cor(finalgenes[[top10malegene]], finalgenes$maxFC)^2
  
  p <- ggplot(finalgenes, aes(y=.data[[top10malegene]], x=maxFC, colour = gender)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) + 
    scale_colour_discrete(name = "Gender") +
    xlim(-1, 12) +
    ylim(-1, 12) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 4, y = 10,
      size=8,
      label = paste0(
        "R² = ", round(maleintr2, 3),
        "\nDiff sRMSE = ", abs(round(DiffRMSE[[top10malegene]], 3))
      )
    ) +
     scale_colour_manual(
    values = c("Male" = "blue"),
    name = "Gender"
  ) +
    geom_abline(intercept=0, slope=1) +
    labs(
      x='Log Observed maxFC',
      y ='Log Predicted maxFC',
      title = paste('Observed vs. Predicted maxFC (Univariate Model):\n Gene', top10malegene)
    ) +
    coord_fixed() +
    theme(
  text = element_text(size = 18),
  axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
  axis.text = element_text(size = 19),
  legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
  legend.title = element_text(size = 16),
  plot.title = element_text(size = 18)
)

  plot_list[[top10malegene]] <- p   # ✅ STORE IT HERE
  
  print(p)
  
  cat("Gene", i, "finished\n")
}


ggsave(
  here("figurespng", "rfk.png"),

  width = 7,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
objects <- list(
  cv_results  = cv_results,
  improvegenes  = improvegenes,
  folds  = folds,
  n = n,
  test_idx = test_idx,

  myfilepath = myfilepath,

  finalgenes = finalgenes,
  predgenematrix = predgenematrix
)

    objects[[name]],
    here("MaleUnivariateScreening", paste0(name, ".rds"))
```
